profile_summary: Android Engineer at Percipere (UK) with end-to-end ownership across the mobile-to-cloud stack, from Android client architecture through Spring Boot backends to AWS infrastructure. Led 4+ production go-lives and 5 product tiles (17 screens, 37+ REST APIs) on a SAP-integrated enterprise warehouse platform deployed across multiple countries. Shipped a fintech Android app that parses Indian bank statements using Gemini Nano on-device AI and ML Kit OCR with zero cloud dependency, and built a full-stack social media platform featuring WebRTC calls, Redis Streams, JWT auth, and CI/CD. Fluent in AI-assisted development (Cursor, Copilot) and deeply curious about the full stack.

experience.title: Android & Full-Stack Engineer
bullets: Delivered 4+ production go-lives end-to-end across UK and international clients architecting Android + Spring Boot solutions on AWS infrastructure and leading UAT sign-off, with zero critical post-live defects.

Led development of 5 product tiles in PerciScan, an enterprise warehouse platform (20-30 concurrent users, Android 8+), spanning 17 screens, 9 filter screens, and 37+ REST APIs; designed an action-routing layer that keeps the Android client fully decoupled from the backend, enabling independent release cadences.
Eliminated hardware lock-in by replacing the Zebra scanner SDK with Google ML Kit behind an abstraction interface, making the product hardware-agnostic and unblocking Play Store distribution.
Built a DB-driven Dynamic Tile System enabling new tiles to be added via a single database entry with zero code changes, allowing instant rollout across all client environments without re-deployment.
Diagnosed a race condition in Apache Camel under peak load and resolved the underlying shared mutable state issue. Zero production incidents since.
Implemented CloudFormation IaC, cutting provisioning time from 4-6 hrs to 15-20 min, and built CI/CD pipelines on AWS and Azure DevOps that delivered 40 with zero downtime.

experience.title: Backend Intern
bullets: Built REST APIs for a co-working space management platform, implementing role-based access control across 3 roles and reducing server response time by 40 ms through query optimisation.

projects.name: Fintech Bank Statement Parser - Android
bullets: Built a two-tier on-device AI pipeline: PDF → PdfRenderer → ML Kit OCR → OnDeviceParser. On Pixel 6+/S23+, Gemini Nano (AICore) returns structured JSON with no internet access and no API key; on all other devices (API 21+), a SmartLabelParser detects column headers by X-coordinate at runtime. Successfully parsed 101 transactions across 5 pages of a Bank of India statement with zero cloud dependency.

projects.name: Full-Stack Social Media Platform
bullets: Architected the platform as Android (Clean Architecture, MVVM, Jetpack Compose) + Spring Boot + Redis, using Kotlin across both layers and deploying on Render.

Implemented WebRTC audio/video calls with a full state machine (ringing → ongoing → completed) and a Redis Streams-based system that batch-flushes every 5 min with an optimistic UI cache, supporting lakhs of concurrent interactions; secured with JWT auth, per-IP rate limits, and a circuit breaker.
Built video playback and capture with ExoPlayer adaptive bitrate streaming and CameraX (75 at 60 fps.
